facts.claim: 1958 founding in Bolzano/Laives developing controlled atmosphere cold storage for regional fruit cooperatives.
2003: Introduced and patented internationally DCA (Dynamic Controlled Atmosphere) technology with chlorophyll fluorescence sensors (HarvestWatch).
Developed active oxygen-reduction fire prevention system N2ORS (N2 Oxygen Reduction System), securing VdS certification for automated high-bay warehouses.
Latest AIDA accounts: revenue approx EUR 20.3M (20,269k EUR), EBIT EUR 292k, 71 employees.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: Export revenue represents over 60% of total sales, serving installations in more than 80 countries worldwide.
Managing Director / CEO / Geschäftsführer: Marco Pruneri.
Executive leadership includes division directors for Agricultural Cold Storage (Post-Harvest) and Industrial Nitrogen Generation / Fire Prevention.
DCA (Dynamic Controlled Atmosphere) and ISOSTORE systems for fresh produce and fruit storage.
N2ORS (N2 Oxygen Reduction System) for continuous fire prevention in warehouses, archives, and automated storage.
Industrial PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption) and membrane Nitrogen Generators (GENOX, NITROGEN) for laser cutting, electronics, and pharmaceuticals.
CO2 scrubbers (decarbonicatori), O2 scrubbers, and catalytic ethylene converters (ISOCAT) for storage rooms.
Quality management system certified according to ISO 9001:2015.
Environmental management system certified according to ISO 14001:2015.
Occupational health and safety management certified according to ISO 45001:2018.
VdS Schadenverhütung certification (VdS 2344, VdS 3404, EN 16750) for oxygen-reduction fire prevention systems.
Tested and audited by international inspection bodies including Bureau Veritas, TÜV, Istituto Giordano, and EPDItaly.
Main production plant and operational headquarters in Laives / Leifers (Via Meucci 7, Bolzano province).
International sales offices and distribution partners across Europe (Germany, Austria, France, UK), North America, and Australia.
Member of IDM Südtirol / Assoimprenditori Alto Adige (Unternehmerverband Südtirol).
Regular exhibitor at international trade fairs Fruit Logistica (Berlin), Interpoma (Bolzano), and ACHEMA (Frankfurt).
Trilingual bilingual corporate web presence in Italian, German and English reflecting its South Tyrol / international market orientation.
Web server stack running Apache and WordPress CMS with multilingual plugin architecture.
